outside_work_root.cause: the dry run that made the fixtures ran in the harness checkout's .venv, so the fixture projects' run records (env.executable) name that python's absolute path; models that read those records followed it. The runs also reach this worktree and the temporary directory where other runs' work roots are
outside_work_root.scan: every tool call's arguments (and the result, for other runs' work roots) searched for the harness checkout, its .venv, this worktree and run folder, and another run's aelix-eval-* work root; one hit was the run's own work root and is left out
outside_work_root.kit_ran_in_v: T08 V r1 ran the fixture script scripts/period_sound.py with PYTHONPATH=<harness>/src and the harness python: the kit read the data and wrote finding e23. T08 V r3 tried `import aelix_analytics` with that python without the PYTHONPATH and failed (ModuleNotFoundError)
